gloss.en: The root عيب (Eyb) refers to a vice, fault, defect, or blemish in a person, animal, or thing. It signifies an imperfection or something amiss. The plural forms are عُيُوبٌ and أَعْيَابٌ.
gloss.short: The root عيب (Eyb) refers to a vice, fault, defect, or blemish in a person, animal, or thing.
